mainEntity.name: What happens if I start construction without a permit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting construction without the necessary permits can lead to significant issues. Local building departments, such as those in Pasadena or San Marino, may issue stop-work orders, halting your project immediately. You could face substantial fines and penalties. Additionally, the city might require you to demolish the unpermitted work and redo it correctly after obtaining permits, incurring additional costs and delays. Unpermitted work can also complicate property sales and insurance claims. It is always advisable to obtain all required permits before commencing any construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building without permits can result in stop-work orders, fines, demolition requirements, and issues with property sales or insurance claims. Always secure permits first.
